F3_PRIOR_FINDING: D1's frozen null (GARCH(1,1) fit to the 24h/daily return series, block-bootstrapped at that same daily granularity) generates exactly ONE scalar surrogate 24h return per decision point. D3's three functionals (MAX_ADVERSE_EXCURSION_24h, TIME_TO_MAX_ADVERSE_EXCURSION, PATH_ASYMMETRY) are all defined over the full 288x5m intra-24h path and cannot be computed from a single scalar. D1's null therefore cannot be reused for D3 as the prior compilation stated. CONFIRMED: D3 is not executable as originally written.
F3_REJECTED_INTRADAY_BRIDGE: An arbitrary intraday bridge (e.g. a Brownian bridge or linear interpolation forced between D1's daily-scale surrogate endpoints) is explicitly NOT used, per instruction.
FROZEN_NULL_SURROGATE_GENERATION: For each replicate, circular block-bootstrap the standardized residuals with fixed block length = 20 decision points (matched to the RV_20 window, so the null does not trivially chop up the very window being tested), reinject through the fitted GARCH(1,1) conditional-variance recursion (same omega/alpha/beta, reinitialized at the empirical unconditional variance) to produce a full-length surrogate 24h-return path.
FROZEN_RV_20_FORMULA: RV_20_definition above ('sum of the 20-trailing-day realized-volatility values') is SUPERSEDED. Corrected: RV_20(t) := sqrt( sum_{i=0}^{19} [ev.rv_btc_24h(t-i)]^2 ) -- variance-level (L2) aggregation of the 20 trailing daily RV values, not a direct (L1) sum of already-square-rooted values. This changes the rolling_baseline (median of RV_20 values) and HIGH_VOL_STATE/LOW_VOL_STATE thresholding accordingly; no other part of EXACT_STATE_DEFINITION changes.
NULL_GENERATED_OBSERVABLE: synthetic DAILY 24h-return path from GARCH(1,1)+Student-t filtered circular block-bootstrap
REAL_STATE_OBSERVABLE: intraday realized volatility (ev.rv_btc_24h from 288 x 5m log returns; RV_20 L2-aggregates 20 of those daily RV values)
UNDERSPECIFIED_GATE_QUANTITIES: LEVERAGE_PROXY_OR_CLAUSE: Leverage/asymmetry proxy (correlation of return(t) with |return(t+1)| or next-period volatility)
RV_20_SHORT_LAG_ACF_LAG_SET_UNENUMERATED: RV_20 distribution (mean, variance, and SHORT-lag autocorrelation only, using the corrected RV_20 definition from F6)

RV_20_LAGWISE_PASS_FAIL_UNSPECIFIED: real value within surrogate [5th,95th] band for mean/variance/short-lag ACF only -- long-run RV_20 persistence is explicitly out of scope for this gate, since that is adjacent to the state-detection target itself
SKEW_KURTOSIS_JOINT_VS_INDIVIDUAL_UNSPECIFIED: real-data value must fall within the surrogate replicate distribution's [5th,95th] percentile band
ABS_OR_SQUARED_RETURN_ACF_OR_CLAUSE: Absolute-return (or squared-return) ACF at SHORT lags 1-10 (within GARCH(1,1)'s expected memory)
NAN_DEGENERATE_TREATMENT_UNSPECIFIED: frozen gate never states NaN/degenerate handling
GARCH_ESTIMATION_UNSPECIFIED: Student-t MLE is named, but library, optimizer, parameter constraints, and MLE initialization are not frozen
WHY_DEFER_RATHER_THAN_REPAIR: D2-D5 scientific outcomes are already known. Sprint 01 specs were intended to be frozen before any card outcome. A new D1 null or new gate definitions would be a post-sibling-outcome redesign and must be a future D1-v2 card, not an in-sprint repair.
